as_told.title: Vimana mercury cylinders compared with the Bell's red mercury

plain: The claim is that the vimanas, flying machines described in old Indian texts, ran on spinning mercury. Michels brings it up himself, in passing, without naming a source. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells it in more detail on another episode: he describes rotating cylinders filled with a form of mercury, without naming where he read it. He sets this beside the account of Igor Witkowski, a writer on secret Nazi weapons, who says the Nazis' Bell, a supposed wartime device, worked the same way. If true, an ancient Indian idea and a Nazi weapons programme would share a single technology.
